title: Getting fired for moving chords; Johnny Brown's band
summary: Players who varied chords were fired and replaced; Verrett recalls Johnny Brown's band and its banjoists.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
